facts.fact: The UNECA/GIZ/AU Commission inception report dated 19 June 2025 says Mozambique has not enacted a comprehensive data protection law but has drafted a Data Protection Bill, and lists a pending data protection law as a challenge.
The inception report states that Mozambique has no data regulatory authority, though INTIC, INCM, INAGE and CEDSIF impliedly oversee parts of data governance.

systems.system: Constitution of the Republic of Mozambique, Article 71
Banco de Mocambique Notice 8/GBM/2021 on consumer data protection
African Union Convention on Cybersecurity and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention)
National Data Governance Strategy and National Data Policy (in development)
